title: What Scripture Actually Says About Running From Temptation (It's Not Cowardice)
caption:
You’ve been told a strong man can stand in front of it and not fall. Scripture never says that.

Joseph didn’t stay to argue. He left his cloak in her hand and ran. Paul didn’t tell Timothy to white-knuckle it. He told him to flee.

Run at the first thought, not the fifth click. And run toward something: a brother, a walk, the Word.

“Flee youthful passions and pursue righteousness.” 2 Timothy 2:22

Save this for the next time you’re standing in the doorway.
